owners.fund: Quinbrook Low Carbon Power LP; Quinbrook Low Carbon Power Parallel Fund (US) LP (indirect)

ownershipResolution.finding: No other/exited direct holder is certified. Cohen's class, units, stake, votes, governance, acquisition date and capacity are undisclosed; no sole/minority/control inference is safe.
ownershipResolution.fundLayer: Continuation Fund LP/Feeder LP share Valley of Fire CF (GP) Limited and Quinbrook Infrastructure Partners (Jersey) Limited as GP/manager; Blackstone, Ares and Partners Group are fund investors only.
ownershipResolution.projectCoOwner: APG announced 49% Gemini for ABP on 2022-10-12; later sources say acquired in 2022. FERC says Lidana Investments, LLC, APG's ADV singular Lidana Investment LLC; vehicle/close unresolved. Gemini-only.

operatingResolution.roles: Primergy manages/develops/operates; Arevia developed. Financing, tax, offtake, EPC and O&M parties are not owners.
operatingResolution.counts: 2024: seven projects including Gemini, >2.65GW solar/potential 1.5GW storage; Nov-2024: Gemini plus five, same ranges; current: eight excluding Gemini, >2.2GW/potential 2.5GW.
operatingResolution.finding: Dates, counting or pipeline changes do not prove equity events. The eight-SPV roster is unpublished. Current PPAs put Sleepy Orange, Hot Pot and Iron Point under Primergy, not Valley of Fire.

acquisitionExitCheck.continuation2024: Quinbrook announced the close on 2024-04-04: the $600m-commitment Valley of Fire Fund acquired 51% Gemini and 100% of the rest from the Low Carbon Power Fund and 'certain other equity holders.'
acquisitionExitCheck.gap: Form D identifies master/feeder funds, but the deal source omits legal buyer/sellers, issuer, securities/units, allocation, rollover, chain and exact close date. $600m is commitments, not price. This is asset perimeter, not Valley of Fire Solar's cap table.
acquisitionExitCheck.later: No later public company equity/control transaction or signed pending deal found through cutoff; silence cannot certify private ownership.
acquisitionExitCheck.nonEquity: The 2024 $225m tax-credit/revolver and 2026 Gemini Class B LLC $601.9m notes/$160m LC are tax/debt events.
